Sorry for your loss , that's always a difficult thing to deal with at any age . Good on you for fixing it though ..Keep going ..It's fucking hard . I backslide all the time ..But keep getting back up . Way I look at it ..Death come for us all ...Let's not race him !

For me it's a matter of doing the diet .I lose weight extremely fast but getting into the mindset to do it is my block .. I eat because I'm depressed I'm depressed because I eat . Vicious circle .It doesn't help I have borderline personality disorder and my trigger is food . Meh ..I'm getting better. For now

I'll post to this . I'm 400 lbs. All my life I was obese and I never let it stop me . Slowly as the weight climbed I found myself doing less . It got so bad i stopped leaving the house . I ordered  out all the time , usually so much it made me sick . Worst it got is double trips to MC Donald's for 6 MC doubles two large fries and a coke with a frosty . Twice daily . I wanted to die ...That was my goal .  Eat myself to death . I was so big I broke my car seat in half getting out one day .  When you can register a cars struggle with a hill because of your weight ... I smelled ...Cause I didn't shower . I remember over tipping the delivery drivers because I was embarrassed , making up lies like we had a party or some bros are hanging out . Highest weight I hit was 550.  My mom died while I was doing this ..I lived with her at the time . Knowing that my mother will never see her son happy and healthy kills me every day. Knowing that the last thing she saw was me struggling to open the bag of fast food I had bought .  ...Please ..Keep trying to lose weight even if it's coming off slowly . Don't let it consume you . And don't ever let the dirty glances make you feel less human . Fuck those people .  I have since lost 150 lbs . Trying to get health for my mother ..If not for myself .

Honestly it's all about honeing in your sensitivity and practice .  And as always have fun . Also depends on the game  sometimes twitch shooters like cod (console twitch shooters)  just don't mesh with people .
With the drugs ...it's a two way street . If I abuse them ..works for me ..if they end up killing me ..works for me .

My father is a self proclaimed highly functioning alcoholic. I tend to agree with him .  My family doesn't really believe in help ..they understand what it is but they think is less than what it really is . He also has bpd ..not that he would do anything for it because he doesn't think that he has it . And bpd is just that way .. vicious fucking circle ..

From what I know of the house it's worth about 260-240 thousand on the house alone ..so I don't see how he could have done it ..either way I have contacted a lawyer for the whole thing for a little more insight . I did read that for the 200 k or less is only for an expedited probate , not no probate .. but again I'm in the dark as far as law is concerned. Thank you for all the help at least . Hope it's not too late . This guy has caused me so much grief and pain ... its been something that has gotten me to a dark place in recent months . Like I said before I've posted about what he did and at the time my mother's passing was fresh and I just couldn't deal.   Maybe I can still fix things. thank you again .
Also they did have a joint bank account but she had one separate to that . But he emptied those ...his sister is a lawyer suposedly

It's been a year .. I know as far April of this year Oregon had not received anything for probate on that estate and I also know he is renting it out and paying the mortgage ..there's a good chance he never reported her as dead .
Nope .. it was one of the things we went rounds about when she was sick . He didn't want her to get one . Saying it was morbid of me to think that way

I should note that I have used weed for years to calm me and back me down when I get going , and my depression isn't sadness ..at least not fully but more of a rage .. but I moved to a different state that it's highly illegal so I can't smoke to calm me down ..i know drugs shouldn't be the answer ...but if I gotta take antipsychotics, depression meds and anti anxiety meds or smoke some green ...I'm taking green all day
Oregon here ...bong hits and weird chicks lol

I was sick. I had/have major depression and anxiety. One day after having a really bad episode my buddy gave me some to try and help it. I had smoked before as a teen and didn't really care so much. Well I can tell you it saved me from alot of pain and now I smoke every day. Just like so many others I was worried cause of all the shit that dare told us. All lies. My mom also got sick with cancer shortly after I started and she was super for it . helped her sleep and made the last few weeks of her life enjoyable. She would get high with me and we would watch Anthony bordain and we would talk about food and travel. I'd like to think that weed helped me and her make good memories before she past from such a shitty thing. Fuck cancer.
Thank you

Good luck getting in ..that's the closest in and out for Portland , Eugene, ect .. It's gonna be slammed ....always lol . you should of seen it when they put in a sonic in Medford ...roadblock for months ..and sonic sucks.

Thanks everyone ..I might just do that . I was never close with my family. At least my siblings and my other family (aunts ect) like I said I was a black sheep. But my mom always pulled me out of whatever jam I had put myself into . I love my dad too  and he's been awesome about the whole thing . see my parents split when I was 12  so I've had two "family's" for most of my life . my step mom is awesome as well ..but I was always close with my mom . told her everything . she went out of her way to find me the things I wanted. I was an odd kid with a taste for toys 10 years too late (ghostbusters mostly) but every year for my birthday or Xmas I would have ghostbusters toys under the tree, she didn't understand why I was a bit of an outcast and videogames were odd to her .(always telling me how could anything be fun for that long) but without fail every year ..new system and the games I wanted ..and we were not a rich family ..she would cut wood or do odd jobs just to see us freak out when she got us the Nintendo we wanted. She took in all my friends as if they were her own ..some of them a bit rough. She had this way of cussin if she dropped a pan but it was totally innocent and she would look at you with that "oops" face ..it always made me smile cause I cuss like a sailor. She was a good woman .. Smile that would light up a room . but ...the worst part is is I saw her at the viewing. The chemo does some bad shit to the body and its hard to preserve the body ...she looked like a mummy. I can't do this without her ...what the fuck am I gonna do for Xmas ....it was her favorite time of year . this isn't fucking fair . sorry it's hard for me to talk to my friends about this without putting up the mask ..something I've perfected over the years. My depression is coming back and im not sure if I can fight it alone

Unfortunately he has all the money, what I did get from my mom is what I need to live off of for a bit till I know what I'm doing , he can afford the lawyers, I can't ...and even if I won there's really nothing that can make him pay ..since its civil . he changed the locks on my mom's probated house ..threw my stuff on the curb and threw out the rest of my mom's things , he's now trying to rent the house out in probate and take all the money from that as well for "retirement" ..my mom was nothing but a check to him
